channel.title: Pier & Point · Third Street Garage
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Third Street Garage (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: The Third Street Garage's 2015 facade removal and January 2020…
item.description: The Third Street Garage's 2015 facade removal and January 2020 facade completion came from an article that could not be read, so they are no longer shown. A structural engineer's page from June 2020 calls the new facade "new" without a date, and the garage's completion date is listed as unknown. Source: Hohbach-Lewin, UCSF Third St. Parking Garage Façade, June 9, 2020 (https://www.hohbach-lewin.com/ucsf-third-st-parking-garage-facade/).
item.source: Hohbach-Lewin, UCSF Third St. Parking Garage Façade, June 9, 2020 (https://www.hohbach-lewin.com/ucsf-third-st-parking-garage-facade/)

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: The Third Street Garage page now cites OpenStreetMap for its…
item.description: The Third Street Garage page now cites OpenStreetMap for its 1650 3rd Street address and labels its 253,993 sq ft as the 2003 planned size beside the contractor's 256,276. Two open questions that contradicted the page were corrected. Source: OpenStreetMap way 27369503; UC Regents Item 4-GF, November 2003 (regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov03/4gf.pdf); Overaa Construction project page.

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: The Third Street Garage showed a 2004 construction start and a…
item.description: The Third Street Garage showed a 2004 construction start and a 2005 completion that were only ever a 2003 projection. Those milestones were removed; the projection is still described, and the garage's completed status now rests on a 2021 report that its original facade was removed in 2015. Source: https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov03/4gf.pdf; https://facadesplus.com/iwamotoscotts-cellular-origami-transforms-a-san-francisco-garage/.

item.title: Correction · Third Street Garage: The 2021 facade replacement was wrong: Facades+ (March 2021)…
item.description: The 2021 facade replacement was wrong: Facades+ (March 2021) says the channel-glass facade was removed in 2015 and IwamotoScott's new facade was completed in January 2020, so the record now shows both. The November 2003 Regents item requests approval of the $23,298,000 budget and does not record the vote, so the record and the related timeline entry now say it was submitted for approval. The March 2004 construction start and July 2005 completion are the 2003 item's plan and are marked expected (no report of the actual dates was found). The map caveat no longer says UCSF land has no Assessor parcel (the footprint is inside active parcel 8711509), the capacity note now cites the contractor's 882 stalls, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: Facades+, 2021-03-15 (https://facadesplus.com/iwamotoscotts-cellular-origami-transforms-a-san-francisco-garage/); UC Regents item, 2003-11-06 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov03/4gf.pdf); Overaa Construction, UCSF Mission Bay Building 23B Parking Structure (https://www.overaa.com/projects/ucsf-mission-bay-building-23b-parking-structure/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8711509 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8711509); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn).
item.source: Facades+, 2021-03-15 (https://facadesplus.com/iwamotoscotts-cellular-origami-transforms-a-san-francisco-garage/); UC Regents item, 2003-11-06 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov03/4gf.pdf); Overaa Construction, UCSF Mission Bay Building 23B Parking Structure (https://www.overaa.com/projects/ucsf-mission-bay-building-23b-parking-structure/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8711509 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8711509); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn)

item.title: Added · Third Street Garage: The $23,298,000 budget submitted to the UC Regents in November 2003…
item.description: The $23,298,000 budget submitted to the UC Regents in November 2003 for the Building 23B parking structure was already noted on this record, citing the same Regents item, which requests approval and does not record the vote. It is now also listed in the record's cost table as a development cost, consistent with every other record. Source: UC Regents Committees on Grounds and Buildings and on Finance, Item 4-GF, joint meeting 2003-11-19 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov03/4gf.pdf).
item.source: UC Regents Committees on Grounds and Buildings and on Finance, Item 4-GF, joint meeting 2003-11-19 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/nov03/4gf.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Third Street Garage: IwamotoScott's "Cellular Origami" facade, more than… (~Jun 2020)
item.description: IwamotoScott's "Cellular Origami" facade, more than 1,500 aluminum panels, is described as the garage's "new façade" on structural engineer Hohbach-Lewin's project page published June 9, 2020; the page gives no installation or completion date, so this shows only that the facade existed or was in design by then (~Jun 2020). Source: Hohbach-Lewin (structural engineer), 2020-06-09.

item.title: Milestone · Third Street Garage: UC Regents' Committee on Grounds and Buildings and… (Nov 19, 2003)
item.description: UC Regents' Committee on Grounds and Buildings and Committee on Finance are asked to approve a $23,298,000 budget, to be funded from external financing, for the Mission Bay Building 23B Parking Structure Project (822 spaces on nine levels plus 52 surface spaces, Block 23); the item, dated November 6, 2003, requests approval and does not record the vote; it says construction is slated to begin in March 2004 and to be completed by July 2005 (Nov 19, 2003). Source: Regents of the University of California, 2003-11-06.
item.source: Regents of the University of California, 2003-11-06
